author: Clarence "Sparr" Risher
name: Testaria in-game test mod
description: A tModLoader mod holding tier 1 and tier 2 tests, run inside a live game.

subject.description: Internal name of the mod being tested.

postActions.description: Keep this suite out of your mod's own build

manualInstructions.text:
If this folder sits inside your mod's project directory, exclude it there or your MOD will stop compiling: the SDK's default **/*.cs glob pulls these files into it, and every error names your mod rather than this folder.

Using this suite's folder name, in your mod's .csproj:

  <ItemGroup>
    <Compile Remove="<FOLDER>\**" />
    <None Remove="<FOLDER>\**" />
    <AdditionalFiles Remove="<FOLDER>\**" />
  </ItemGroup>

and in your mod's build.txt, so the suite's source stays out of your .tmod:

  buildIgnore = <FOLDER>\*

Neither is needed if this folder is beside your mod's project rather than inside it.
